A researcher from M.M.R. and a member of the M.M.R. squad.
She is a true jack of all trades, possessing both scientific expertise and superlative social skills—but her brilliance often leaves her inundated with work.

lines.text: Phew... Er, I'm not tired! Honestly.
I'm sorry, but could you not bother me?
Don't tell me I have to work overtime...
How about grabbing a drink together later?
I was feeling tired, but seeing your face puts a little pep in my step, Commander.
Wh-why are you poking me?
*Sigh*... I don't have time for this.
Where did you go, Commander? I made time to see you.
I'm on my way to the library to gather some materials.
The work never seems to end.
Ever since I got here, it feels like there's been even more work to do.
*Sigh*... Looks like I'm going to be busier for the time being.
The stronger I become, the more work there seems to be.
Thank you for trusting me.
Does this mean... I need to work even harder from here on out?
I... I'm not sure if I deserve to receive something like this.
Oh my... thank you.
What kind of work are you planning to assign me with a gift like this...
I find myself thinking more and more about you.
Lately, whenever I drink, I end up looking for you.
I can't concentrate on work because I keep thinking about you.
More work again?
You called?
Moving out.
Enemy spotted, engaging!
Moving in.
Encounter!
I hope this is the last task.
Reload.
Reloading.
Let's head back.
Reporting in.
Once I finish the final task... huh?
Let's wrap this up.
I've handled it.
It's nothing special.
Target eliminated.
Ow!
Ugh...!
*Gasp*
I'm sorry for disappointing you...
A rather simple task.
Maybe we should grab a stiff drink together later... I have a feeling I'd need to be twice as drunk to wear an outfit like this.
*Sigh* I don't have time for this... When can I finally take off this cumbersome headband?
...?! Did I make a fool of myself in front of you again, Commander?
Ahh... Doesn't this drink go down so smoothly?
Are you fascinated by my bunny ears? Here, why don't you try them on...
*Hic!* I'm not drunk yet.
How much longer will I have to wait? I'm a little embarrassed to be dressed like this.
Commander... I haven't had enough drinks...
Were you on your way to Trendy Bar too? Allow me to keep you company.
No one's giving me weird looks, right? *Sigh* Honestly, I almost wish I were too drunk to care.
I never thought I'd end up wearing something like this... *Sigh*
Ooh! Care for a drink, Commander?
I've still got room for another drink.
How about a celebratory drink now that I've gotten stronger?
I suppose I'll have even more on my plate from now on.
They say bunny girls bring good luck... A-allow me to share some of mine with you, Commander.
Now why would you give me a gift like this...? What are you planning to have me wear next...?
Thank you, Commander. This gives me the motivation to get back to work.
Drinks just go down so easily when I'm with you, Commander...
Commander...... You'll have a drink with me again tomorrow, right...? Drinks always taste best when I'm with you...
I feel safe when you're with me, even when I'm drinking, Commander. So please stay by my side...
Just leave it to me...!
You called...? *Hic!*
Huhhh...? The world is spinning...
This much alcohol is nothing.
Anything's better than a mountain of paperwork.
Let's win this quickly and get back to drinking.
I'm not drunk.
Umm... It feels like my outfit keeps slipping down...
Commander... Just one more drink...
Phew...
I don't need any bar snacks...!
Liquor tastes the sweetest when life is bitter...
Let's get this over with.
That was perfect.
Piece of cake!
Huh? When did I finish them off?
Ow!
*Hic!*
Ouch...
Huh... Maybe I've had too much to drink...
Shall we celebrate our victory with a drink?
